title: llm-kit project model file, version 1
description: The tracked project model file (default .llm-kit/models.yaml) after YAML parsing. Written in llm-scripting-kit.json-schema-subset/v1. Reader rules this subset cannot state: text values have no leading or trailing whitespace; catalog ids are unique; an efforts list has no repeats; a selection names a catalog id; a selection effort is in the row's efforts when the row declares them, and is null when the row declares an empty list; an integer is in -(2**53 - 1) to 2**53 - 1; version and max_output_tokens are integers, not decimals such as 1.0. Contract and shared cases: docs/reference/llm-kit-formats.md.

row.description: One catalog row. Omitted efforts: the row does not narrow the effort menu. efforts []: the row has no effort.

selection.description: A selection key's model (a catalog id) and effort. An omitted effort and a null effort mean the same: no effort.
